description: This file defines the BlockingCounter class in the Abseil synchronization library, providing thread synchronization primitives for blocking until a count reaches zero.

classes.name: BlockingCounter
classes.description: A thread synchronization utility that blocks until a specified number of events have occurred.

methods.name: BlockingCounter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the counter with a specified initial count.

methods.name: DecrementCount
methods.description: Decrements the internal count by one; returns true if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until the count reaches zero.
